title: The manager's tick starts with a self-check of its tools, rules, hooks and host
goal: backlog.py selfcheck prints, capped, whether the allow rules in .claude/settings.json cover the commands the skills run, the commit hooks and the plugin are installed, the host is within its load and lock limits, no claim is stale, no owned orphan runs and main is green, each failure with the remedy the kb-sprint skill names; the manager runs it at every tick and acts on a failure before it dispatches work, or records why it cannot.

gates.question: This adds a mechanism before a failure it answers has happened (backlog.md, Changing this process). Add it anyway?

notes: Its state output is the one capped command of ST-nrhwbodb; each failed check names a remedy a stalled item uses too (A1).
